worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.summary: Borrow the Eternal Flower's power and burst a thick piercing ray from a bloom in any direction or at a world point: it runs through the whole line, is cut short at a real block, and can be fired at empty space. The recoil follows the damage actually dealt - the more you ruin, the more it ruins you.
worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.descriptio: A ray pierces a corridor along the aim, hitting up to %4$s targets from the nearest outward, once each, for about %1$s Fairy special damage; the ray reaches %2$s blocks and is %3$s blocks half-wide, stops at the first real block, and a target blocked by an obstacle is not hit.
Each hit reflects %1$s× the damage actually dealt back onto the user; a miss or an immune target costs nothing.
worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.overdraw.o: Overdraw: borrow one step harder for power ×1.1 and a 1.15x wider ray, at the cost of recoil ×1.15, +2 wind-up and +6 cooldown.
Restraint: recoil ×0.8 at the cost of power ×0.95 - you pay back less, but each hit lands lighter.
worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.growth.0: From level %1$s the ray power steps up to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.growth.1: From level %1$s the ray power reaches %2$s and the recoil rises to %3$s×.
worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.use.0: A thick piercing ray through the whole line ahead
worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.use.1: Make the recoil follow only the damage actually dealt
worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.use.2: Overdraw and gamble one shot on clearing the line
worldcombat.skill.lightofruin.preference: On: borrow one step harder for power ×1.1 and a 1.15x wider ray, at the cost of recoil ×1.15, +2 wind-up and +6 cooldown. Off (restraint): recoil ×0.8 at the cost of power ×0.95 - you pay back less, but each hit lands lighter.
Above this distance the companion closes in before firing. Higher fires sooner and wastes the recoil more often.
How many bodies must line up before the companion fires. Higher saves the ray for queues; at 1 it fires at a single target too.
Below this health fraction the companion stops firing (unless the target is at 30% health or less). Recoil follows the total damage dealt, so a lower threshold gambles a piercing shot more freely.
